verdict.rationale: Missive documents AI-assisted reply composition in the app (missive-docs-49). Its assistant and MCP-connected apps like Claude can create draft replies for review (missive-docs-21, missive-docs-45, missive-docs-20). Nothing in the evidence shows the drafts adapt to the user's own voice or tone rather than generic output. missing for 10: learning or matching personal writing style/tone, controls for tone or voice customization, independent or hands-on corroboration of draft quality.
